question: Salutations, your Grace. Forgive me for robbing your Grace's precious time but I bring a question. During the bath scene of Volume 23, the men attempted to peek at the nubile bodies of Nami and Vivi. Now, although I can comprehend why Sanji, King Cobra and Igaram wished to peek... Why in the hell did Luffy, Usopp and Chopper peek too?! PLEASE ANSWER ME(SERIOUSLY)! If you don't give me a serious answer, I... I... I'll SUE YOUR PANTS OFF! -President of the Association to Prevent Peeping Boys, Shikobaya Pinoko-
answer: Why, you ask? Well, that's because they are all healthy boys. I don't think there needs to be any other reason than that. But for Chopper, he might have done it just because everyone else was. Frankly, to not want to peep on a beautiful girl when she's naked is a great disrespect to that girl in my o- Ahem, I mean, in Sanji's opinion.
